description: This file defines a helper class 'facebook_helper' for interacting with the Facebook API within a larger project. It includes methods for retrieving user information, newsfeeds, login/logout URLs, and processing different types of Facebook stories into HTML snippets.

classes.name: facebook_helper
classes.description: A helper class for integrating Facebook API functionalities, such as fetching user data, news feeds, and processing stories into HTML format, within the application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Facebook object with configuration details.

methods.name: get_my_user
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: get_my_newsfeed
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated user's news feed.

methods.name: get_other_newsfeed
methods.description: Fetches the news feed of another user specified by username.

methods.name: get_login_url
methods.description: Generates a Facebook login URL with specified permissions.

methods.name: get_facebook_user
methods.description: Retrieves Facebook user information for a specific username.

methods.name: process_feed
methods.description: Processes a Facebook story based on its type (status, photo, link, video).

methods.name: photo_status
methods.description: Generates HTML for a photo story.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Generates HTML for a status story.

methods.name: link_type
methods.description: Generates HTML for a link story.

methods.name: video_type
methods.description: Generates HTML for a video story.

methods.name: get_to
methods.description: Extracts the recipient's name from a story.
